Hi Alice,

I found the resume template download links for you. Due to system restrictions, I'm unable to directly download and send the file, but you can use these links to download it yourself:

Main download link: https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf
Part 2 download link: https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template_part2.pdf

You can also visit the main site at: www.resume-templates.com/download_links

The templates are clean and professional, perfect for job applications.

If you any issues downloading or need further assistance, please let me know!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
